about_the_game:
Pathfinder 2 RPG - Season of Ghosts AP 4: To Bloom Below the Web

The Season of Ghosts comes to an end!

With the arrival of spring, the town of Willowshore can begin to recover from the ordeals brought on by a harrowing winter. The sinister curse that afflicted the town may have been lifted, but repurcussions quickly manifest as a new murderous threat invades the region, even as the town's heroes navigate dangerous political terrain with the monstrous rulers of their nation. Will Willowshore ever find peace?

To Bloom Below the Web is a Pathfinder adventure for four 10th-level characters. This adventure continues the Season of Ghosts Adventure Path, a four-part monthly campaign in which a band of adventurers must protect their hometown from supernatural peril. This adventure also includes an article to help continue your campaign beyond the scope of this Adventure Path, a look at horrific urban legends, spells and feats the PCs can encounter in this adventure, and a mix of brand new monsters to threaten your PCs.

Each monthly full-color softcover Pathfinder Adventure Path volume contains an in-depth adventure scenario, stats for several new monsters, and support articles meant to give Game Masters additional material to expand their campaign.

This product is not a PDF or accessible outside of Fantasy Grounds. It has been lovingly converted for use within Fantasy Grounds and features the following additions:

<ul> <li> All maps resized and set up with a preset grid to make combats easy to manage</li>
<li> Individual area descriptions linked to maps, containing new encounters, treasure parcels and descriptions for just that area</li>
<li> Tokens for each encounter are all pre-placed in starting locations on the map. You can edit these on the fly.</li>
<li> Drag and drop treasure parcels and Encounter XP that is easily awarded to your players to keep the game moving ahead</li>
<li> All the images and handouts from the book available to share with your players as you need them</li>
</ul>"
